reason: A Windows portable launcher that downloads required runtime components, installs DeepSeek Harness locally, and starts its local Web UI with progress, retry, resume, and browser-opening support.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 Windows 的便携式启动器，可自动准备 Node.js 和 DeepSeek Harness，并启动本地 Web UI。
summaries.en: A portable Windows launcher that prepares Node.js and DeepSeek Harness locally, then starts the local Web UI.

capabilities: Downloads portable Node.js from configured mirrors
Launches a local DeepSeek Harness Web UI service
Opens a browser to the local Web UI
Writes local startup logs and setup state files
